name: agentwalletapi
description: Crypto wallet for AI agents on Ethereum, Polygon, Base and Solana. The agent gets an API key, never a private key, and your spending limits and allowlist are checked before anything is signed. Send, swap, bridge, trade on Polymarket and get paid through escrow.

agent_key.title: OpenClawCash agent API key
agent_key.description: Your OpenClawCash agent API key (starts with occ_). Create one at openclawcash.com under API Keys. It is stored by Claude Code, not in this plugin, and is only ever sent to openclawcash.com.
